component.description: The Frost-Star EX cooler comes to you from J-Span, a manufacturer with a well deserved reputation among ship owners for constructing coolers that can reliably handle heat exchange wherever you may fly.

component.description: Designed to be able to process atmosphere to above UEE standards, the ComfortAir life support system from Tyler Design & Tech provides you and your crew with a clean and comfortable environment.

component.description: Sakura Sun knows exactly what you need. The DayBreak is a straightforward power plant that provides parity to its performance, durability, and stealth stats.

component.name: Odyssey
component.description: Adventure amidst the stars awaits with the Odyssey quantum drive. Careful and continued refinement from the Tarsus team has kept this component on the cutting edge for centuries.

component.name: Excelsior
component.description: Journey across the ‘verse with Tarsus’ Excelsior jump module, offering greater reliability to help take your wanderlust to new heights.

component.name: Chernykh
component.description: The Chernykh is named after the famed 26th century engineer who designed some of the most prized radars of that era. This medium radar from WillsOp celebrates both the look and performance of those classic components.

component.name: VariPuck S3 Gimbal Mount
component.description: The VariPuck fits between your weapon and the ship hardpoint to transform a fixed weapon mount into a gimballed mount, allowing the pilot to independently aim their weapon’s fire. VariPucks will accept any weapon the same size as the hardpoint it is mounting to.

component.name: CF-337 Panther Repeater
component.description: The CF-337 Panther is the size three model in Klaus & Werner's laser repeater line. The Panther is a true fire-and-forget weapon with a respectable power consumption-to-damage ratio. Pilots who outfit their ships with Panthers rarely regret the decision.
